verify_commands.dd_text: The /dso:onboarding security step writes both require_codeql and require_code_quality keys to dso-config.conf, each defaulting to false, during project setup
github-bootstrap.sh invokes provision-ruleset.sh passing the require_codeql and require_code_quality values read from dso-config.conf, applying them on a ci-pr project
A configuration-isolated test asserts onboarding emits both keys defaulting false AND github-bootstrap passes them through to provision-ruleset.sh, and the test passes
